Onsite

RTX is an aerospace and defense company whose research organization, BBN Technologies, develops advances in areas including machine language translation and quantum cryptography. The Research Software Engineer I will work on AI-based planning and scheduling, compiler or operating-system capabilities, and prototype software development, collaborating with colleagues and incorporating feedback to deliver practical solutions to complex problems.

Responsibilities
Work with a small team on cutting-edge research and development projects, focusing on AI based planning and scheduling (e.g., in the context of joint all domain command and control), novel compiler (e.g., LLVM passes) and/or OS-related (e.g., kernel modules, userland services) capability development
Design and develop prototype software using the latest open-source technologies
Receive and incorporate feedback from end users, field tests, and exercises
Explore technical possibilities collaboratively with motivated, world class colleagues
Deliver practical solutions to complex problems
